description: This PHP file defines the ClaimExpenseTypeAPI class, which is an API endpoint managing CRUD operations for expense types within a Claim system. It includes methods for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting expense types, with detailed OpenAPI annotations for documentation.

classes.name: ClaimExpenseTypeAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class for managing CRUD operations related to Claim Expense Types in the system, including listing, creating, updating, retrieving, and deleting expense types with integrated validation and OpenAPI documentation.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all expense types, supports filtering, sorting, and pagination, returning a collection result.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new expense type with submitted details, validates input, and saves the new record.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a single expense type by ID, including checks for existence and usage status.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing expense type, with logic to prevent editing certain fields if the expense type is in use.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove expense types by providing their IDs, with validation and existence checks.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the getAll method query parameters.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for creating a new expense type.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for retrieving a specific expense type by ID.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for updating an existing expense type.

methods.name: getNameRule
methods.description: Creates validation rule for the 'name' property, including uniqueness constraints.

methods.name: getClaimExpenseTypeCommonUniqueOption
methods.description: Creates a common unique property option used during validation to ignore certain values like isDeleted.

methods.name: setExpenseType
methods.description: Sets properties of an ExpenseType entity from request parameters, including description and status, and associates the user.
